alloy.preparation: Induction melted in argon by the split-heat technique with successive Mo additions; hot forged and hot rolled to 0.76 cm strip, then cold rolled to 0.38 cm. Standard anneal 1 h at 815 °C and water quench. Epoxy-mounted with one surface parallel to rolling plane; polished by standard metallography to a distilled-water slurry of 0.3 µm alumina; exposed surface 0.5 × 0.6 cm; edges masked with clear Glyptal varnish to reduce crevice corrosion.

test_method.procedure_description: Saturated calomel reference; platinum auxiliary separated from test solution by glass frit. Scanned from −0.7 V toward noble potentials. Below room temperature an ice bath was used; elevated temperatures controlled by heating mantle and controller. Post-test microscopic examination required well-developed pits away from masked edges; edge crevice attack alone invalidated a run.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Extremely sharp current rise marking stable pit growth, with microscopic confirmation of distinct developed pits away from masked edges. Small transient pulses before this threshold were not stable propagating pits.

Post-test microscopic examination required well-developed pits away from masked edges; edge crevice attack alone invalidated a run.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Extremely sharp current rise marking stable pit growth, with microscopic confirmation of distinct developed pits away from masked edges. Small transient pulses before this threshold were not stable propagating pits.

alloy.preparation: Induction melted in argon by the split-heat technique with successive Mo additions; hot forged and hot rolled to 0.76 cm strip, then cold rolled to 0.38 cm. Standard anneal 1 h at 815 °C and water quench. Additional tested heat treatment: water quenched from 1035 °C; duration of this treatment not specified. Epoxy-mounted with one surface parallel to rolling plane; polished by standard metallography to a distilled-water slurry of 0.3 µm alumina; exposed surface 0.5 × 0.6 cm; edges masked with clear Glyptal varnish to reduce crevice corrosion.
